purpose: Teach: いとも/まぎれ/分り/むやみ/待ち受け/飽きる/とっとと/有り得

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、いとも自然に絵を描き始めるのよ
lines.en: Sho, you and Mei-sis just start drawing like it's the most natural thing in the world.
lines.style: Warm observation, slight wonder in the voice. Watching him with gentle attention. Soft cadence, almost thinking out loud about what she's noticed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祭りの群衆にまぎれてもメイ姉さん見つけるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, even in a crowd at the festival, I'd find you.
lines.style: Quiet certainty without boasting. Direct eye contact through the voice. Small, genuine conviction — the kind of promise a child makes when he means it completely.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの絵は本当に分りやすいのよ
lines.en: Sho, the pictures you and Mei-sis make together — they're so clear, so easy to understand.
lines.style: Gentle pride, speaking as if to herself. Noticing aloud. Warm reflection. No urgency, just appreciation settling in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、むやみにお絵描き道具を買わないようにするよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to be careful not to just buy art supplies without thinking.
lines.style: Earnest commitment, small voice but solid. He's made a decision and is telling her because it matters. Slight formality — this is a promise.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがメイ姉さんの絵を待ち受けにしてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad keeps your pictures as his phone wallpaper.
lines.style: Soft delight, sharing a secret that makes her happy. Slight lift in warmth. Speaking it like a small gift she's giving him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描きは飽きる事がないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I never get tired of drawing.
lines.style: Simple, bright certainty. The eagerness of a six-year-old discovering something true about himself. Open-hearted, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、「とっとと描いて」なんて、メイ姉さんは決して言わないわよ
lines.en: Sho, I would never rush you — never say "just hurry up and draw."
lines.style: Firm gentleness, a quiet promise. Low and steady. Each word carries care. The reassurance that he has all the time he needs with her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんに会えるなんて、有り得ないって思ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I never thought I'd actually get to see you again.
lines.style: Soft, almost dazed wonder. The realization breaking through into his voice. Quiet awe that something he'd decided was impossible turned out to be real.
